# Synthetic native SDK adapter fixtures

These files construct tiny **synthetic** SDK, retained-group and original-observation
models for passive adapter tests. Every program, target library, archive, runtime
module and raw observation is inert fixture data. No SDK installation, version
probe, compiler, archive extraction or engine operation produced these records.
Their real file hashes establish only fixture consistency. Admission success is
candidate metadata, never original execution, native compatibility or eligibility.

`fixture.py` writes only into a caller-owned fresh test directory. The immutable
SDK model has complete declared files/modes and Linux case-distinct headers;
external interpreter facts and portable host extensions live outside it. Frozen
adapter/template controls are copied into an isolated repository replica so
mutation cases never edit canonical source. Outputs remain disjoint from inputs.
